title: Compress closed current-cycle execution plan
outOfScope: Deleting immutable Work Item Contracts, Summaries, manifests, release evidence, or historical plans.
Changing historical implementation claims or the published v0.5.47 Release.
Deleting a plan that is still referenced by a Contract, Summary, archive, or Release evidence.

sources.reason: Defines the plan retention policy: current plans may be compressed to a closure index while immutable archive evidence remains authoritative.
The current execution plan states WI-19 must run last after release and preserve audit evidence.
Authoritative immutable index for completed Work Item evidence.
Provider evidence that the current release completed before final plan cleanup.

riskAssessment.reason: Removing the wrong plan could break audit references; the Work Item must prove reference-safe compression and retain Git recovery paths.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized the complete plan including last-stage execution-plan cleanup after release.

preReviewWarnings: Do not delete historical plans or immutable evidence; only close the current-cycle execution plan into a navigable audit index.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: The plan index no longer labels the 2026-07-25 remediation plan as current execution after v0.5.47 and its post-publish corrective PR are closed.
The plan is retained as an archive-backed closure index with release, final PR, and Work Item archive references rather than deleted.
No immutable archive, Release evidence, or historical plan is deleted, and all referenced paths resolve.
The required generated pre-release documentation-alignment report is refreshed through its canonical generator after the plan status changes.
Focused documentation/reference checks and required governance gates pass; full local quality remains optional under the user's temporary efficiency approval while Hosted CI remains required.
guidelines: Preserve audit evidence and Git recovery paths.
Make no capability, release, or implementation claim beyond evidence.
Keep the cleanup limited to documentation status and reference-safe compression.

intent.problem: The plan index still presents the 2026-07-25 remediation plan as current execution even though v0.5.47 was published, the final post-publish corrective PR #539 was merged and closed, and branch cleanup is complete. The user explicitly requested final cleanup of execution plan documents.
constraints: Retain the original plan text, immutable Work Item archive, Release evidence, and Git recovery path.
Do not delete historical plans wholesale or silently erase unresolved history.
Use focused verification under the user's temporary efficiency approval while retaining governance gates and Hosted CI.
intent.rationale: The appropriate cleanup is a truthful closure index: it removes the false active-plan signal while preserving historical context and authoritative audit evidence.

verification.reason: Temporary user-authorized focused-verification exception; it does not waive governance gates or Hosted CI.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user authorized continuous execution of every planned Work Item, including final plan cleanup.

rollbackNote: Revert only this documentation-index Work Item if needed; archived Work Item and provider evidence remain untouched.
rawUserRequest: 最后发版本之前，将远端，本地的分支都整理干净。发布完成后清理执行计划文档。继续。

declaredIntent.summary: Close the current-cycle execution plan into an audit-preserving index after verified release and branch cleanup.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The final release and post-publish corrective Work Item are closed.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The plan index marks the remediation plan closed and links to authoritative release and archive evidence.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inspect provider Release, PR #539 state, branch/worktree state, archive index, and plan references.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Historical plans remain available for audit.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Only current-plan status changes; no archive or historical plan is deleted.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Reference scan and Git diff verify retained documents and valid links.
